wire_name_note: named is the existing internal wire constructor, not a selected public Alch spelling

optional.field_absent: accepted and normalized to null in value comparison
optional.nested_optional_element: rejected by existing decoder, including list<optional<T>> and set<optional<T>>

collections.set: unordered; duplicate semantic keys rejected; empty accepted
collections.element_equality: Entity by declared identity; Value Object by complete values; Enum/sum by tag and payload

sum.payload: required only for payload-bearing alternatives; otherwise forbidden
sum.lane: existing typed-sum contract on Enum; not a change to ordinary Enum body semantics

identity.entity: exactly one required identity property; String, UInt64, or finite Value Object composed of those types
identity.value_object: no identity properties; nonempty invariant references retained, not executed
identity.entity_equality: declared type selector and identity value; all other fields still validated
identity.value_object_equality: declared type selector and all field values

bindings.identity_reference: explicit target Entity and identity property; source may wrap that identity type in optional/list/set
bindings.field_projection: explicit declared target and finite property path; exact projected type parity required
bindings.identity_field_binding: rejected; identity must not be defined through reference metadata

cycles.embedding: rejected even through optional or collection constructors
cycles.entity_identity_references: accepted when identities are finite; no recursive embedding implied

values.shape: closed JSON objects; unknown/missing required fields and accessors rejected
values.open_content: unsupported and rejected; no lower-assurance open lane silently enabled
values.uint64_outside_envelope: reject; full UInt64, decimal strings and bigint require a separately selected realization

claim_ceiling: candidate contract and in-process TypeScript validator only; no default compiler integration, cross-language realization, invariant enforcement, database binding or DEC-05 admission
